To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
blaCTX-M-encoding plasmides of ESBL-E were commonly disseminated among pork meats, wholesale meat market workers, and UTI patients.
the blaCTX-M55-encoding 10–139 kbp-size plasmid was common in the pork meats, wholesale meat market workers, and UTI patients.
the blaCTX-M55-encoding 100–139 kbp-size plasmids were found in pork meat, workers, and UTI patients.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the spread of blaCTX-M55-encoding 105–139 kbp-sized plasmids among pork meats, wholesale workers, and patients in a community in Vietnam.
the prevalence of blaCTX-M encoding plasmids in pork meats and the dissemination of the plasmids to workers and patients with ESBL-E55 UTI in Vietnam.
the prevalence of ESBE-E55 in pork meat, workers, and patients in Vietnam, which may provide useful information for the prevention of ESBL-E in the future.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
blaCTX-M-encoding plasmides are commonly found in pork meats, workers in the same wholesale market and patients with UTIs.
the 104 to 139 kbp blaCTX-M-5-encoding plasmides were commonly found in pork meats, the wholesale market workers and the patients with UTI in Vietnam.
ESBL-E55 harbored 104–139-kbp blaCTX-M-encoding plasmides were widely disseminated among pork meats, wholesale workers, and patients.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the blaCTX-M55-encoding plasmin was widely disseminated in the pork meat, workers and patients with urinary track infection.
ESBL-E55 is commonly found in pork meats, workers from the same market, and patients with a UTI from a hospital nearby the market.

blaCTX-M-15-encoding plasmides were found in 100% (n = 10) of ESBL-E isolated in the study, and blaCTX-M-27-encoding plasmide was found in 50% (n =5) of ESBL- Eisolated in the study. blaCTX-M-14 and blaCTX-M 55-encoding plamides were found in only one sample of ESBL-Eisolated in the current study.
The main takeaway from our work is that
blaCTX-M-155-encoding 104-139 kbp plasmas are commonly found in pork meats, and they are disseminated among workers and patients with a UTI in Vietnam.
blaCTX-M- 55-encoding plamids of 104–139 bp are commonly disseminated in ESBL-E in pork meats, workers from wholesale markets, and patients with a urinary tract infection.
blaCTX-M-encoding plasmides of 104–139 kb were commonly disseminated among pork, wholesale market workers and patients with urinary infection.
